GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 6.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # wide/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keen early. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 4 Lengths , Moved Up to 1 length Two Wide (8 Lengths tearaway Leader came back) turning, dropped right out in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported disappointment in the performance opining it races best when it has more control of the tempo over the 1600m distance.] # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr N. Tomizawa reported that he was disappointed in the performance & was of the opinion that the gelding races best when he has more control of the tempo when racing at the 1600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Two Wide Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, got some cover middle stages, loomed 3 Wide on the corner and looked like the winner but he Just peaked with big weight last 200m and faded # big weight/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Reared when gates opened. Raced keen early. Steadied when close to heels over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then Went Forward to lead Two Wide by 0.75 Lengths settling down, Held Together in front & led rail by a head turning, Headed 200m and weakened final 200m. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stage.] # worked a bit early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & Settled Down Mid Field 4.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4 Lengths turning, improved only marginally in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # midfield throughout
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keen early. Approaching the 1200m when racing keenly, eased after improving up onto heels, then continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages.
Fractious in barriers, began awk and lost ground. Ridr could offer no expl for the performance, however may not have handled the firmer track.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , Moved Up and took Two Wide Lead at 850m, Held Together in front & led rail by 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed Straightening Up , kept trying but lost a couple of lengths to the line. [Stewards: raced keenly early/middle stages.] # battled on fairly
Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind Leader 2 Lengths 800m, came off fence Straightening Up and looked chance but Just battled last 200m and did not finish off # did not finish off

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6 Lengths 2-3 wide, 3 Wide from 700m, trailed 7 Lengths 3 Wide turning, made the home turn awkwardly shifting wider, improved only marginally in Straight # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide from the 700m. Made the home turn awkwardly and shifted wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 3 Lengths rail, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened noticeably
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 750m improved onto heels, eased and shifted out.
